cover_headline: Nifty Down 13 Percent Faces Worst Year in Decade as Strategists Urge Caution

end.headline: Nifty Down 13 Percent Faces Worst Year in Decade as Strategists Urge Caution
end.line: Spark Capital says slowing growth, high crude and stretched valuations may cap returns despite expected 20% September-quarter profit growth, while brokerages see only a technical November rebound.

facts: India's Nifty 50 has fallen about 13% this year and is on course for its worst annual performance in over a decade
Nifty 50 companies are expected to deliver 20% profit growth in the September quarter, their fastest pace in three years
The Nifty briefly dipped into oversold territory in October, with its relative strength index below 30

quote.speaker: Thyagesh Baba
quote.text: The old model of borrowing at 18%-20% to fund businesses generating 11%-12% returns on capital has largely faded.
